description: Curated evidence mapping used by scripts/reconcile-sim-profile-answers.mjs to keep historical_figure_users.json binary answers consistent with the canonical demo vote fixtures. Profile questions reference the all_300_questions.json policy list via commentIndex; this config links those policy indexes to demo_polis_data.json comments (via verbatim key_tension matches) and, where no POLIS vote exists, to manually validated atlas tree nodes with explicit polarity. Tree-node mappings are only allowed on nodes whose tree votes empirically agree with the node's anchor POLIS statements (anchorCommentIndexes) for at least 80% of figures that have both signals; sim_profile_answer_consistency.test.js enforces this.

8.rationale: An IAEA-style international regulatory body is a binding-regulation instrument; positive Regulation Approaches tree votes are anchored pro-binding-regulation by the validated POLIS[4]/POLIS[5] mappings (95% directional agreement).

10.rationale: Mandatory pre-deployment safety testing and certification is binding regulation; same 0x3100 anchor.

15.rationale: Mandatory safety-incident and near-miss disclosure is binding regulation; same 0x3100 anchor.

16.rationale: Adversarial auditing by competing labs as an effective regulator is the voluntary/market-sufficiency inverse of the pro-binding-regulation 0x3100 anchor.

17.rationale: Real-time regulator monitoring and override authority is binding regulation; same 0x3100 anchor.

62.rationale: Mandatory interpretability requirements for high-stakes AI decisions are binding regulation; same 0x3100 anchor.

65.rationale: Requiring AI agents to disclose their AI nature follows the pro-synthetic-labeling direction anchored by the validated POLIS[19] watermarking and POLIS[20] deepfake-labeling mappings (83% directional agreement).

78.rationale: Platform liability for AI-generated misinformation follows the pro-intervention direction of the same 0x4230 anchor.
